comparison.objective: Identify hidden cable endpoints and place only the correct plugs into holders.
comparison.physical_skill: Interactive cable tracing, careful tugging, cable handling, and plug placement; no mechanical adjustment or force-limited fastener work.
comparison.success_condition: Correct red and blue plugs released in matching holders while three distractor plugs stay within 5 cm and no cable pulls out.
comparison.reason: Tests identity inference through cable motion and selective placement.
